'''Xexto''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[Limb/Legends|four-armed]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]], where they lived in arboreal villages. [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]] the [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] was a Xexto.

Xexto should not be confused with the similarly long-necked and multi-limbed, but larger [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] species, the genetic derivative which [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] scientists developed from the Xexto.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:XextoQuermian.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Xexto with a [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]].]]
Xexto spoke the language [[Xextese]]. These spindly invertebrates normally measured from 1.1 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] (3.6 ft) to 1.5 meters (4.9 ft) in height. They had 6 [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] that sprouted from their small centrally located torso along with a long neck and small head. They had 4 arms with 6 fingers each, and 2 legs with ten toes each. Their large [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were normally a [[Color/Legends|dark purple]] or black. Their skin could range from chalk white to a pale yellow or purple. Their brain was split between two parts of their body; the part located in the skull controlled primitive emotions and basic body functions, while another portion in their chest controlled higher functions such as creative thinking and logic.

On their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]], the primary predator of the Xeto were vicious [[challat eater]]s, which were defied through both agility and cunning.

Xexto admired thrill-seeking and taking big risks. Despite this, Xexto were fairly level headed and cool tempered.

==Personality==
Due to the difficult terrain and dangerous predators found on Troiken, the Xextese grew to admire and encourage risk-taking, and questioning a Xexto's bravery would make them very angry. Despite their risk-taking nature the Xexto tended to be well mannered and even-tempered.

==History==
[[File:Xexto-SoT.png|thumb|left|180px|A [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] for the Rebel Alliance]]
The Xexto were first encountered under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in approximately [[17,000 BBY]], by an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] geneticist looking to continue [[Rights of Sentience|illegal]] research outlawed by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. At the time the Xexto were loosely organized into hunter-gatherer tribes on Troiken. The geneticist relocated a portion of the population to the nearby [[Quermia/Legends|Quermia]] and commenced experimentation. This experimentation lead to a new species called the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermians]]. Eventually the geneticist abandoned both species, fearing the wrath of the Old Republic.

Although vastly different in size, the Quermians continued to share many qualities with their smaller cousins. Both possessed their elongated necks for peering above mats of vegetation, while (from a purely sociological standpoint) both races preferred to hide their second set of arms under clothing for decorum's sake.

Neither of the species would remain primitive, and were developing technologically advanced civilizations by the time Galactic Republic scouts contacted them. Both the Quermians and the Xexto joined the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] community soon thereafter.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gasgano-TPM.png|thumb|right|200px|Gasgano]]
The Xexto species was first introduced in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']], with the podracer [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]]. The conceptual maquette of Gasgano was designed by [[Richard Mills]] and [[Robert E. Barnes]], and his appearance in the film was computer generated.
